info.longName: PIMCO Preferred And Capital Securities Active Exchange-Traded Fund

funds_data.description: The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its assets in a diversified portfolio of preferred securities and capital securities. capital securities” include securities issued by U.S. and non-U.S. financial institutions (including, but not limited to, banks and insurance companies) that can be used to satisfy their regulatory capital requirements.
